title: Open Mic Night @ O'Shaughnessy's Pub
event_description: Classic open mic night in historic Old Town Alexandria. All musicians welcome - acoustic guitars electric instruments and more. Hosted by Damian Anderson. Relaxed dive bar atmosphere with friendly crowd.
event_venue_information:
O'Shaughnessy's Pub - Old Town's Iconic Dive

O'Shaughnessy's Pub located at 1324 King Street in Old Town Alexandria is a legendary dive bar that has become a cultural institution in the neighborhood. Formerly known as the Laughing Lizard Lounge the venue maintains an authentic unpretentious atmosphere that welcomes locals and visitors alike.

Open Mic Mondays

Every Monday at 8pm O'Shaughnessy's hosts open mic night hosted by Damian Anderson. All skill levels and instrument types are welcome - acoustic guitars electric instruments and vocals. The relaxed dive bar setting creates a comfortable environment for both experienced performers and those trying open mic for the first time.

Live Music Programming

Beyond Monday open mic the venue features live music Tuesday through Saturday nights. The programming ranges from comedy to live bands creating a diverse entertainment calendar. The downstairs stage area provides an intimate venue for performances.

Classic Dive Bar Atmosphere

O'Shaughnessy's retains classic dive bar charm with multiple pool tables upstairs an attached NYC-style deli serving hearty sandwiches and a jukebox. The casual friendly vibe emphasizes community and good times over pretension. Customers describe it as the last authentic dive in Old Town.

Location & Convenience

Located on King Street in the heart of Old Town Alexandria the pub is easily accessible and surrounded by historic shops restaurants and galleries. The area has become gentrified over the decades making O'Shaughnessy's continued existence as an authentic local hangout even more notable.
